text: Shutting down Sora is a good thing.  AI video slop generation is just a waste of GPU allocation and energy.

author.name: Job K Joseph
author.headline: Director - Hi-tech | Global Presales Leader | Enterprise Strategy | CXO Advisor | Thought Leader | Insight-Led Digital Transformation /Growth Partner

comments.text: I think even overcasual use of any AI tool is an environmental sin. I would love if all AI tools would : (1) show an estimate of tokens and/or energy required to fulfil the task, before we click send (2) generate a daily or weekly usage report for each user/license
